name: offshore-wind
description: 600 MW of offshore wind on a Baltic hex two steps off Nadmorze (01 §5.2, 02 §8.1 in 0.22), reached the way 0.26 makes you reach it — an extra-large farm (300 MW, the top rung) and then a second extra-large one expanded onto the same hex once the first stands: 2.5x CAPEX for the site, 2 game days to build, and an HV spur ashore because 600 MW does not fit an MV line (500 MW). The spur is ordered on turn 0 straight onto the farm's building site (01 §3.3 in 0.23): 2 hexes x 12 h is one game day against the farm's two, so the wire is standing when the turbines arrive - and the farm therefore lands connected and RUNNING instead of switched off (§5.2 in 0.23). Days 0-1: the corridor Modrzyca - Turow - Nadmorze goes up and the start CCGT alone carries all three cities to a 310 MW evening peak. Day 2: the farm comes online into the storm month and the run turns red (-5,7 mln) - not because the wind is missing but because the setpoint log keeps the gas plant where it was, so 1 420 MW-turns of wind and 1 222 of gas are dumped at once and both are charged 400 zl/MWh (01 §4.1 in 0.23). The curtailed figure flickers 439 - 57 - 0 - 174 - 380 as gusts cross the 25 m/s cutout inside single blocks (06 §6.3). Day 3: the storm peaks, 600 MW reads near zero all day and the gas plant carries the north alone - which is what it is for - for the best day of the run (+13,7 mln). Days 4-6: the sea comes back near rated power, the plant sits low and 1 400-2 500 MW-turns per day are still curtailed, because the MV corridor south caps what the north can pass on. Six days end at +32,2 mln: an offshore farm pays back in years, not in a week, and since 0.23 an oversized one pays rent on every MWh the grid cannot take. The run is 06 §12.14 played out - offshore is base energy, not firm capacity.

corridor south: Nadmorze - Turow - Modrzyca, where the start CCGT already stands

corridor stands - both northern cities become customers
day 1 - two more cities: the CCGT alone carries the whole north
day 2 - the farm comes online on a spur that is already standing
the sea hex holds a second extra-large farm; the ladder tops out at the LAND cap, so 600 MW is two orders (01 §5.2 in 0.26)

day 4 - the sea comes back at rated power and the plant goes to zero for two days
one block where the wind dips below the evening peak
